|game_text=Deploy on [[Mara Jade]]. May add 1 to Force drain where present. During battle, Mara may use a blaster and this weapon. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E3 of [[Mara Jade's Lightsaber (V)]] (version 4 of 4); it is the current text. The image is the Players Committee card image, which prints this text. Versions in date order: [[Mara Jade's Lightsaber (V)]] (original, release sheet of 11 May 2012); [[Mara Jade's Lightsaber (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); [[Mara Jade's Lightsaber (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original); '''this page''' (PC-E3, Players Committee card image, uploaded 7 May 2013, the same words as PC-E1, the current text).
* '''Original''' ([[Mara Jade's Lightsaber (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet (official text as of 11 May 2012)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=5 Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"), page 5, slip 25 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=5 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on Mara Jade. May add 1 to Force drain where present. During battle, Mara may use a blaster and this weapon. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-p5-26-Mara_Jades_Lightsaber.png]]) prints it. The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Dark Side p. 21) prints this text again; under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E2 ([[Mara Jade's Lightsaber (V) (Errata 2)]]); the current text is the PC card image uploaded on 7 May 2013 ([[Mara Jade's Lightsaber (V) (Errata 3)]], which prints the card-list wording).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=59, page 59. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=59 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Mara Jade's Lightsaber (V) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) dropped “its” (“Target hit, and forfeit = 0”)<ref name="cl-1281_25-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive); the same text in the captures of 12 December 2012 and 11 January 2013 and on the Virtual Master list (VMasterType)</ref>: “Deploy on Mara Jade. May add 1 to Force drain where present. During battle, Mara may use a blaster and this weapon. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value.” The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-marajadeslightsaber-pre.gif]], undated) prints it. The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Mara Jade's Lightsaber (V) (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 59)<ref name="ml-ds" /> prints the original release-sheet text ([[Mara Jade's Lightsaber (V)]]) again, word for word: “Deploy on Mara Jade. May add 1 to Force drain where present. During battle, Mara may use a blaster and this weapon. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value.” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text); the PC card image uploaded later (this page) is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1281-25-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip and the PC card image.
* '''PC-E3''' (this page): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-marajadeslightsaber-pre.gif]]) prints the PC website card-list text ([[Mara Jade's Lightsaber (V) (Errata)]], PC-E1) again, word for word: “Deploy on Mara Jade. May add 1 to Force drain where present. During battle, Mara may use a blaster and this weapon. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value.” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual8-Dark card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 7 May 2013, 13:52<ref name="pcdir-Virtual8-Dark">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034744/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). Uploaded after the Master List, it is the latest version and so the current text. It brings back the card-list wording, so the current text is the card-list wording again, not the Master List's (the same case as Assassin's Blaster Rifle; the upload date is the only date known for the image, and it may have been made before the Master List). The PC card image prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip.
